contract_note: Task instruction fixed 22 CSV columns. docs/02 was changed externally during the session to a 9-column final business CSV; shared/task-spec.md records that this round keeps the 22-column results as old-contract evidence and does not rerun. No docs/ or shared/ file was modified by this implementation.
time_origin: build_started_at; both first_* values are seconds after it

requests_breakdown.note: Browser subresources are excluded; this is not network-level request count.

coverage.notes: The denominator is the number of public product URLs in the site's product sitemap at discovery time. Covered counts candidates with a processed verdict in this bounded task, not the whole catalogue. The sitemap can change between runs and is not independently audited.

build_errors: Plain HTTP probes (curl, including a proxy bypass) returned 429 local_rate_limited with retry-after: 60 for product and collection pages; a real Chromium page returned 200 for the same product page. These probes are not part of the measured run.
network_note: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY are present. The browser used the platform's default network path; the actual egress was not independently measured. No credentials are recorded.

resource.cleanup: browser pool closed; post-run process snapshot found no Chromium/Playwright process

fix_task.change: Post-run selector fix: the description selector matched an empty .product__description.rte placeholder on two products and recorded it as a DOM-captured description. The fix requires non-empty text, uses .product__description.rte first, distinguishes an empty source container (not_provided) from a missing container (failed), and records selector/empty-container evidence. Added 3 contract tests (16 total).

final_package.note: The package root is the fix rerun (v2); the first bounded trial (v1) is archived under diagnostics/run-001/.

limitations: Bounded trial: 30 product pages or 10 minutes, whichever comes first. The main run processed 25 and the fix rerun 27; neither is whole-site coverage.
The 706-URL sitemap denominator is point-in-time and not independently audited. coverage.status=KNOWN describes the denominator, not a full crawl.
tax_basis is UNKNOWN for every product because the source does not state inclusive/exclusive pricing; the reason is recorded per row.
No real-run product had a partial or fallback description; those states are covered by synthetic contract tests, not by this site's live sample.
The main trial left 5 products pending and the fix rerun left 3 because the 10-minute watchdog stopped the crawler.
Pause/resume is not implemented; Ctrl+C cancels and --resume replays a checkpoint. A normal run purges its Crawlee queue and is a new task.
Plain HTTP probes hit 429 local_rate_limited during build; the measured run used Chromium and had no 429 or retry. The probes are not part of the run counts.

The Crawlee throttler's per-domain sub-manager wrote queue JSON to a repo-root storage/ directory in addition to the per-run storage. The directory was removed and contained no page content; run-scoped storage isolation is a follow-up.
The actual network egress was not independently measured; HTTP(S)_PROXY variables were present and the browser used the platform default path.
